title_en: See an Exclusive Preview of Comixology's Battle in the Flower Gardens, a Beautiful Coming-of-Age Story Heavy on Video Game Nostalgia
summary_en: Check out our exclusive first look at Battle in the Flower Gardens, a new coming-of-age graphic novel with a heavy dose of video game nostalgia.
body_en:
Having trained under no less a modern master than American Vampire co-creator Rafael Albuquerque, Brazilian cartoonist Eduardo Medeiros is definitely a rising star in the comic book world. Medeiros is following up projects like Roderick and the City of Morhil and Funny Creek with Battle in the Flower Gardens, a coming-of-age story with a heavy dose of video game-flavored nostalgia.
IGN can exclusively debut the first preview of this new Comixology Originals graphic novel. Check it out in the slideshow gallery below:
Batte in the Flower Gardens is written, drawn, and colored by Medeiros, with lettering by Deyvison Manes. Here's Comixology's official description of the book:
"Battle in the Flower Gardens is a story I’ve been wanting to tell for a long time," said Medeiros in a statement. "When I was a young boy, my family had a tradition of spending every summer at Capão Novo, a beachside town in southern Brazil. It's where I have some of my fondest memories and much of that has found its way into this book."
Medeiros continued, "This book is deeply personal and the process of creating it took me on a sweet journey back to the days of my youth. I hope readers enjoy the story and I encourage them to reminisce about the experiences that have shaped them."
Battle in the Flower Gardens will be released on the Comixology platform on August 25, 2026.
For more, check out our exclusive preview and interview for Black Panther/Namor: Doomed .
